## Review checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the requested scope and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Requirements, API/database documentation, and ADRs reflect the final change where applicable.
- [ ] Verification and limitations are reported accurately.
- [ ] No real personal information, private QR links, credentials, or secrets are included.
- [ ] Ownership checks, independent statuses, and safe link handling were considered where applicable.
